data_fields.name: footprint tile cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 81 valid tiles (9 x 9), above which the footprint falls back

best_idea: Before a build is committed, judge each proposed tile one at a time, price only the tiles that pass, and show the count and total so the player sees what they will pay for.
decision_why: No current Frankendom feature lets players place footprints, and zones are authored data (a ruling), so adopting this would add a second layout path; keep the preview-count idea for a future plot feature.
acceptance: If built later: a server test asserts that a 3 x 3 request with 4 failing tiles charges for 5 tiles only, and is refused when money is below 5 times the per-tile price.
